mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: Locally grown food always has fewer food miles, even if it travels through a distant warehouse.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Putting the same food on sale reduces its food miles even when its delivery route stays unchanged.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Food miles stop at the shop; carrying the food home does not count.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The fresher-looking apple has fewer food miles, even though it travelled farther.

intelligence.enrichment: Food miles are the entire distance travelled by a food item from the producer to the consumer; reducing food miles helps cut down cost and pollution. shorter producer-to-consumer travel distance -> fewer food miles -> lower cost and pollution The learner correctly applies this rule: Food miles are the entire distance travelled by a food item from the producer to the consumer; reducing food miles helps cut down cost and pollution. Food miles means the distance a person travels to buy or eat food, not the food item's producer-to-consumer travel.
